package consumer

type SearchInput struct {
	ID   int    `query:"id" param:"id" default:"7"`
	Q    string `query:"q" default:"all" validate:"min=1,max=64"`
	Page int    `query:"page" default:"1" validate:"min=1,max=1000"`
}

type StaleInput struct {
	Q string `query:"q" default:"old"`
}

type UnsupportedInput struct {
	Value string `query:"value" validate:"required"`
}

type ChangedValidationInput struct {
	Page int `query:"page" validate:"min=1"`
}
